items.english: Thus an arbitrarily given system of quantities (e_1,...,e_p) can be brought into the form (sum alpha_1,...,sum alpha_p) [in only one way] if it is not congruent to a system of the form (-sum_1^{p-2} alpha_1,...,-sum_1^{p-2} alpha_p), and in infinitely many ways if this is the case.
